basic_profile.bio: I’m a 28-year-old graphic designer from San Francisco. Gaming is my escape from the design deadlines and client calls. I’m a huge fan of indie games like OMORI and enjoy discussing game strategies and theories in my free time. In addition to gaming, I’m quite interested in electronic music production, which led me to explore subreddits like Serato. As for my personal life, I’m happily single and spend most evenings online, either gaming or participating in subreddit discussions. I’m not a morning person, so my activity usually peaks in the late afternoon and evening. I have a penchant for quirky, dark humor, which sometimes reflects in my comments.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, which contributed to my analytical and creative thinking skills. My love for gaming is mostly self-taught, stemming from years of playing various genres and discussing them online. I also dabble in music production, learning through online tutorials and community advice.
